title: Uncle Wang the Woodcarver
summary: Wang Lin settles on an old street in Nan's capital, where he dreams of his parents and finds his killing energy condensing into pearls. The boy Zeng Daniu from the blacksmith's across the road befriends him, and Daniu's parents welcome the new neighbour with home-made wine. Over a year Wang Lin carves the villagers of his home and the beasts he has fought, and when Xu Tao buys a dragon carving for ten taels of gold, Baiyun Sect cultivators at the Southern King's residence see that it is a real treasure. Two of them come to the shop to steal more, flee from a Nascent Soul cultivator, and are made to pay 4,500 taels of gold. At New Year the crown prince sends gifts and offers the residence's help, and Wang Lin tells Daniu that he already has a wife waiting for him far away.
events: Wang Lin dreams of his parents; his killing energy forms pearls
Zeng Daniu and his parents befriend their new neighbour
A year of woodcarving: home villagers and beasts like the Zhong Gu and Fire Spider
Xu Tao buys a dragon carving; the Southern King's cultivators recognise it as a treasure
Two Baiyun Sect cultivators try to loot the shop and are made to pay in gold
At New Year the crown prince sends gifts; Wang Lin speaks of a wife far away
cultivation: Nan's crown prince: Qi Condensation level 8. Zhou Qiao: late Foundation Establishment; Weng Qi: early Core Formation (both Baiyun Sect).
